## LmdbQueue.dequeue() method

Dequeue the head atomically (read + delete in one synchronous transaction).

**Signature:**

```typescript
dequeue(): Promise<[string, ValueOf<S>] | undefined>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;\[string, [ValueOf](./lmdb.valueof.md)<!-- -->&lt;S&gt;\] \| undefined&gt;

The dequeued `[id, job]`<!-- -->, or `undefined` when empty.

## Remarks

The first key is read through a synchronous cursor (`getKeys({limit: 1})`<!-- -->) so the write transaction is never held open across a microtask by an async `first()` materialization.
